object_description: polygonal autonomous volume linked to an existing building
design_condition: The new volume mediates between historic and newer urban structures, managing the height difference through passages and terraces while restoring a public-square frontage and improving pedestrian connections.

positive.statement: The project relates precisely to the urban context and creates a clear relationship between historical components.
The autonomous volume becomes a pivotal point of connection with its surroundings.
The polygonal shape impresses with its proportions and context-derived guidelines.
The sequence of outdoor spaces, including the courtyard space, is interesting and enriched by additional introverted spaces.
The main entrance is attractive and enlivens the public space.
The central staircase becomes a joint between existing and new buildings and supports encounter and cultural exchange.
The compact design allows an understandable and realizable building-technology concept, with investment costs expected within the specified limits.
The project accommodates a large public use in a historically sensitive urban location in a sophisticated way.

negative.statement: The high transparency of the architectural expression could be scaled back somewhat to support integration with the surrounding buildings.
The proposed flat-ceiling structure and its mode of action need to be clarified in more detail.
